# esolang test fixture sources

ruby interpreters for esoteric programming languages, used as parser test
fixtures. sourced from esolangs.org wiki pages and github repos.

these are *not* original work -- they exist here solely as test inputs for
the goruby parser. see each esolangs.org page for licensing / authorship.

all esolang wiki content is available under CC0 -- see
https://esolangs.org/wiki/Esolang:Copyrights. github repos retain their
respective licences.
